text: Pranav Dubey is an AI Engineer and a final-year Computer Science student (B.Tech) at Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT), Bhopal, graduating in 2027. He is based in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. He builds deep learning, computer vision and GenAI systems end to end: training the model, wrapping it behind an API, and deploying it.
Pranav's work experience: he is currently an AI Engineer Intern at AthlezTech, working remotely, since November 2026. This is his current internship.

Pranav is open to AI Engineer, Applied ML, Machine Learning Engineer and Computer Vision Engineer roles. He wants work that does not stop at training a model: systems that are trained, served behind an API, deployed and used by real people. He enjoys the whole journey, from understanding the problem and improving the model to designing the backend and shipping the final system.

Pranav's main projects, the three featured on his portfolio: 1) NewsCheck, which takes a viral post, finds recent news coverage, groups outlets that copied each other, and shows which independent sources agree or disagree with the exact sentence each one said (Groq gpt-oss-20b, Tavily, hybrid retrieval, every quote verified word for word). 2) Congenital Heart Defect Prediction, chest X-ray classification of Normal, ASD and VSD with a secure clinical backend (ConvNeXt, 82.6% accuracy). 3) AI Video Surveillance, anomaly detection for CCTV (ResNet50 + LSTM, 0.803 AUC-ROC, beats the 0.754 Sultani et al. baseline). His resume also lists the AI Email Agent, voice and text to Gmail (GPT-4o-mini, Whisper, 94.2% recipient accuracy).

AI Video Surveillance project links: live demo on Hugging Face Spaces https://huggingface.co/spaces/Pranavdubey1725/ai-video-surveillance and code https://github.com/pranavdubey1725/AI-VIDEO-SURVEILLANCE-ANOMALY-DETECTION-SYSTEM . Key design decisions: ranking loss (Sultani et al., 2018) so the model learns from video-level labels alone; train/val/test split by video so clips never leak across splits; checkpoints chosen on validation AUC with weighted sampling to offset 76% normal clips; YOLOv8 and Grad-CAM run only on flagged clips, and an async job queue absorbs analyses that take 20 to 120 seconds.

Congenital Heart Defect (CHD) Prediction project links: live demo https://chd-for-epics.vercel.app/login.html and code https://github.com/Ekta-9/CHD-Project . It classifies chest X-rays as Normal, ASD or VSD inside a secure records system. Pipeline: chest X-ray, CLAHE, dual-branch ConvNeXt, FastAPI ML service, Spring Boot backend with 22+ REST APIs, PostgreSQL. The Spring Boot backend calls the model service with retry and backoff, and the system uses JWT auth, role-based access, encrypted patient data and an audit log.

Automated Email Agent project links: live demo https://email-agent-system-three.vercel.app and code https://github.com/pranavdubey1725/Email-Agent-System . Built with React, Node.js, Express, GPT-4o-mini, Whisper, Gmail API and Google OAuth. It turns a spoken or typed request into a ready-to-send email, lets the user review it, then sends it from their own Gmail. Median parse latency is 1.05 seconds at about $0.06 per 1,000 parses. A browser silence gate skipped 90% of unnecessary Whisper calls.

NewsCheck project links: live demo https://newscheck-ed7r.onrender.com/ and code https://github.com/pranavdubey1725/NewsCheck . NewsCheck shows evidence instead of verdicts: paste a viral post and it reads the claim, searches recent news with Tavily, groups syndicated copies, and reports which independent sources agree, disagree or don't address the claim, quoting the exact sentence each said. There is no truth score or 'fake' label. Built with Python, Groq (openai/gpt-oss-20b) with structured outputs and tool calling, Tavily, fastembed (bge-small-en-v1.5), Qdrant, BM25, FastAPI with Server-Sent Events, an MCP server, and Docker.

How NewsCheck works and what it achieved: the model reads the claim, a search agent picks its own queries (code caps the searches, always adds a fact-check search and keeps the claim read-only), copies are grouped by overlapping 5-word phrases so one wire story on forty sites counts once, sentence-aware chunks are retrieved with hybrid dense + BM25 search fused by reciprocal rank behind a 0.55 relevance floor, the model judges each detail of the claim and code computes the stance, and every quote is checked word for word against the article (a paraphrase gets one retry, then the source is reported as not addressing the claim). Results: retrieval hit@2 of 0.79, hybrid search raised hit@1 from 0.55 to 0.66, and the relevance floor keeps 100% of answerable sources while silencing 75% of irrelevant ones. It also runs as an MCP tool for Claude.
